Author: Yu
Name: Viet Translator
Punchline: Hien thi cot truyen FFXIV bang tieng Viet.
Description: Phu de tieng Viet cho thoai FFXIV. Overlay chu co dau chuan (font BeVietnam Pro), giu nguyen ten rieng tieng Anh. A Realm Reborn, Heavensward, Stormblood, Shadowbringers, Endwalker va Dawntrail (toi 7.5): MSQ day du cung nhiem vu Nghe/Job, Role, Duty va mo khoa tinh nang; nhiem vu bo toc (beast tribe) ARR-Stormblood: day du 12 bo toc. Them thoai boss trong dungeon/trial/raid tu ARR toi Dawntrail, va cac su kien mua 7.x. Khong bao gom side quest. Ban dich ngoai tuyen, khong sua du lieu game.
